messages:
ellie (sr PMM): kicking off thread for the benchmark + webinar launch. need: 1 hero headline A/B, 3 short battlecard counters vs cloud providers/LLM API vendors/infra runtimes, webinar agenda bullets, and lead routing rules. keep it field-friendly.
diego (growth): timeline? want landing + ad creative by Tues. webinar scheduled next Wed EOD.
rina (content): ok. I'll draft social copy and a one-slide benchmark summary. need the bench topline: latency, cost per token delta, and outage tolerance note. omar can confirm numbers.
omar (solutions eng): I have recent cluster runs. safe claims: maintains steady p95 under realistic pacing; batching + cache reduces per-token CPU by significant percent (we should avoid exact percent w/out approval). we can offer a downloadable bench CSV for verified customers.
laura (sdr lead): routing: bench downloads -> growth SDR queue; private-demo -> solutions-eng-led handoff; enterprise-interest -> AE + priority flag. SLA for private-demo scheduling: 48-96h.
diego (growth): propose webhook tags: [interest:bench_download|private_demo|enterprise], lead_priority: [normal|priority], product_area: [dedicated|hosted|private]. send to /webhooks/lead-intake.
ellie (sr PMM): hero copy A: "Ship LLM features with production certainty." B: "Inference that meets SLAs—and your budget." short A/B to test.
rina (content): alternate micro-variants for social: "Predictable latency. Lower unit cost. One API." and "Keep models fast and spend predictable, wherever they run."
omar (solutions eng): battlecard counter bullets (short):
- Against cloud AI platforms: "Not just model hosting — we control inference economics and latency SLOs."
- Against LLM API vendors: "Private deployments + VPC options for regulated data flows."
- Against infra runtimes/open stacks: "Opinionated runtime: built-in batching, cache and rollout safety so teams don't rebuild ops."
diego (growth): add one-liners for reps to use on calls: "If latency variability or noisy neighbors have bitten you, Redwood gives consistent p95 under real load." and "We help customers cut token spend via batching + KV caching without reengineering prompts."
laura (sdr lead): add qualification script: 
"Are you evaluating for hosted vs private? (hosted/private)"
"What's your SLA target for p95 latency? (ms)"
"Any restrictions on data leaving your VPC? (yes/no)"
set lead tags accordingly.
ellie (sr PMM): webinar agenda bullets (short):
- 10m: benchmark highlights — latency & cost patterns
- 15m: live demo: failover & rollout controls
- 20m: customer playbook: hosted -> dedicated -> private migration
- 15m: Q&A + next steps
rina (content): slide CTAs: "Download full bench" and "Request private demo". use gated download to get company role + use-case.
omar (solutions eng): for bench wording: allowed phrasing: "Redwood maintains stable p95 latency and uses batching/caching to lower per-token work in our tests." can't use absolute ratios without legal sign-off.
diego (growth): analytics events we'll track: landing_variant, bench_download, demo_request, webinar_register, post-webinar-demo. set UTM tags.
ellie (sr PMM): reps battlecard snippets (3 lines max each):
- "Reliability: SLA-backed dedicated pools + automatic fallbacks to prevent outages."
- "Cost optimization: batching, KV caching and quantization guidance to reduce token spend."
- "Operations: same API across hosted/dedicated/private so you deploy faster."
laura (sdr lead): routing note: for bench_download include field 'eng_contact_preference' (email|slack|calendar) so SDRs know outreach method.
rina (content): social copy drafts ready by EOD; will include 2 creative hooks: metrics-first (bench tease) and fear-of-unpredictability (latency story).
ellie (sr PMM): PR hook suggestion: "New benchmark and playbook: how to run LLMs with predictable latency and cost" — ok to float to comms?
om ar (solutions eng): deploy-bot: deployment completed for the latest bench run.
deploy-bot: bench artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-benches/2026-03-20/latest.csv
ellie (sr PMM): action items: rina (social+slide deck) by EOD; diego (landing + tracking) by Tue; omar (bench-approved phrasing) by Wed AM; laura (routing + SDR script) by Wed AM. reconvene Wed 10am PT. :calendar:
